transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have twenty-four drums of solvent waste from the recent line-cleaning operation secured in the hazardous-waste cage, and the temporary storage permit expires on Friday, so we need to move on disposition quickly. Before I can record any disposition decision, I need us to complete the two-part waste-closeout review. Jon, I'll need you to present the current laboratory and waste-log information for these drums. Priya, I'll need you to present the current batch-genealogy and hold information. Once we have those records in front of us, we can determine whether the material meets the approved recovery specification and proceed with the appropriate disposition commitments on the closeout form. Let's get started.

transcript.text: I received the laboratory classification report yesterday. It shows 15 drums meet the approved solvent-recovery specification, 3 drums fail the water-content limit and must go to hazardous-waste incineration, and 6 drums were not classified in that report. A laboratory-system outage has kept the report from being uploaded to the waste log, so the waste log does not yet reflect these results.

transcript.text: I've completed the batch-genealogy review.
